title: Tenma Tsukasa — Big Brother's Agony〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Tsukasa's Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Just one week left until the Doll Festival...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Saki's in good health as well, so she should finally be able to enjoy it the way she deserves.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Her being in the hospital made it so she really couldn't enjoy it properly, but we can make up for all of that this year!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which is why my little surprise is going to play a vital role in this celebration.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hehehe. She won't know what to do with herself when she finds out what I'm getting her!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But first, I need to find out what kind to get and where...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa? You're still awake?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-Yes! Yes, I am...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're up late as well...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, yeah... I'm just...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was always in the hospital around this time of year, so my mind's been sort of wandering in that direction...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then I saw that the light was still on in your room, so I came to take a peek...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I know you're not alone anymore, but I couldn't help myself...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: You have to go home soon, don't you, Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're right, I do...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: It'll be dark by the time you get home...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It'll be dark and I'll be all alone.)

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: If you ever start feeling lonely, Saki, just try thinking about all the plays and books we talked about!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: That way, you'll feel better knowing that we can play tomorrow and fall right asleep!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
Okay...!
You're really coming tomorrow too, right?

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! I'll come back tomorrow and we can compete to see who finds that man in the striped shirt the fastest!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I really like those books, so you won't beat me that easily!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Saki's always seemed like she was happy and full of energy, but I knew she didn't like having to spend nights at the hospital all by herself...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I thought everything would be okay now that she's finally back home with us but...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki, would you like me to make us some cocoa?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks, Tsukasa...
But I'm okay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I feel better after just talking to you a little.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm not scared of being all alone at night anymore.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know that you, mom and dad are right here with me now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, I can chat with Ichi and the girls until I doze off too now♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki, you know that's not good for you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I know, but it's so much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, I can finally go to bed after each day knowing that I had fun and I'm enjoying life!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I fall asleep each night so excited about what I'm gonna do tomorrow too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki, you still remember that...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I do. It's just like you said, Tsukasa. Think about what was fun that day and what you'll be doing the next.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sleeping is a part of that fun for me too♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. But you need to be careful not to oversleep too. You don't want your perfect attendance to be blemished, do you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, that's true.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So off to bed with you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay. Don't stay up too late either, Tsukasa.
Good night...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Good night, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's make this year's Doll Festival the best ever!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, it will be!
